about.title: About BhoomiTayi
about.subtitle: Your trusted online marketplace for buying, selling & renting services.
about.mission_p1: BhoomiTayi is an online marketplace platform headquartered in Bangalore, India. Our mission is to simplify the process of buying, selling, and renting services by connecting providers directly with genuine buyers and customers.
about.mission_p2: We leverage modern technology to create a seamless experience where users can discover, evaluate, and connect with verified sellers across multiple categories — homes, accommodations, vehicles, commercial spaces, electronics, and more.
about.mission_p3: Founded in 2026, BhoomiTayi has quickly grown to serve thousands of users and sellers across 500+ cities in India, with over 10,000+ verified listings on the platform.
about.what_we_do_intro: BhoomiTayi operates as an online marketplace that:
about.what_we_do_1: Connects buyers and customers with verified sellers and service providers
about.what_we_do_2: Facilitates inquiries and scheduling between parties
about.what_we_do_3: Provides a secure and transparent environment for discovering services
about.what_we_do_4: Charges a nominal listing fee for verification and platform maintenance
about.what_we_do_5: Offers powerful search tools to help users find the right service across multiple categories
about.feature_verified_listings_desc: Browse thousands of verified listings across multiple categories including homes, vehicles, commercial spaces, and everyday items.
about.feature_verified_sellers_desc: All sellers and service providers on our platform go through a verification process to ensure genuine listings and reliability.
about.feature_secure_desc: We use industry-standard security measures including encrypted data transmission and secure authentication to protect all user information.
about.feature_fast_desc: Our streamlined process makes it quick and easy to list your service or find exactly what you need in just a few clicks.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1_intro: When you use BhoomiTayi, we may collect the following information:
privacy.section1_item1: Account Information: Name, email address, phone number, and city when you create an account.
privacy.section1_item2: Listing Data: Listing details, images, descriptions, and pricing that you submit when creating a listing.
privacy.section1_item3: Usage Data: Pages visited, search queries, and interactions with listings to improve our services.
privacy.section1_item4: Device Information: Browser type, device type, and IP address for security and analytics.
privacy.section2_item1: To provide and maintain the BhoomiTayi platform.
privacy.section2_item2: To facilitate communication between sellers and interested buyers or customers.
privacy.section2_item3: To send important notifications about your account and listings.
privacy.section2_item4: To improve our services and develop new features.
privacy.section2_item5: To prevent fraud and ensure platform security.
privacy.section3_intro: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with:
privacy.section3_item1: Other Users: Your name and contact details are shared with users who inquire about your listings.
privacy.section3_item2: Third-Party Services: We use trusted third-party services for hosting, analytics, and email delivery.
privacy.section3_item3: Legal Requirements: We may disclose data if required by law or to protect our rights.
privacy.section4_body: We use industry-standard encryption and security measures to protect your data. All data is transmitted over HTTPS, and passwords are securely hashed. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacy.section5_item1: Access and download your personal data.
privacy.section5_item2: Update or correct your profile information.
privacy.section5_item3: Delete your account and associated data.
privacy.section6_body: We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain your session, remember your preferences, and analyze usage patterns. You can control cookie settings in your browser.
privacy.section7_body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at

tommy.home_welcome_tip: This is India's trusted property marketplace. Browse houses, land, PG rooms, commercial spaces, vehicles and more. Use the search bar to find listings by category and location, or click 'Sell' in the navigation to list your own property. Tommy is here to guide you on every page!
tommy.sell_category_tip: Pick the type of listing you want to create — House, Land, PG, Commercial, Vehicle, or Commodity. Each category has its own specialized form with relevant fields. Choose carefully as this determines what details you'll fill in next!
tommy.listings_tip: Explore all available listings on the platform. Use the category filter to narrow down to houses, land, PG, commercial spaces, vehicles, or commodities. Sort by price, date, or location. Click on any listing card to view full details, photos, and contact information of the seller.
tommy.login_tip: Sign in with your Google account to unlock all features — create and manage listings, save your favorite properties, receive inquiries from interested buyers, and track your listing payments. It's quick, secure, and free!
tommy.dashboard_overview_tip: Welcome to your command center! Here you get a quick snapshot of your account — total listings posted, how many are active vs pending approval, total inquiries received from interested buyers, and recent activity. Use the sidebar to navigate to specific sections like My Listings, Favorites, Inquiries, and Profile.
tommy.dashboard_listings_tip: This is where all your posted listings live. You can see each listing's status — 'Active' means it's live and visible to buyers, 'Pending' means it's waiting for admin to verify your ₹10 UPI payment. You can edit listing details, upload new photos, or delete listings you no longer need. Use the download button to get a PDF receipt of any listing.
tommy.dashboard_favorites_tip: All the listings you've bookmarked with the heart icon appear here. This is your personal shortlist — use it to compare properties you're interested in, track price changes, and quickly access listings you want to revisit. Remove items anytime by clicking the heart icon again on the listing.
tommy.dashboard_inquiries_tip: When someone is interested in your listing, their inquiry shows up here with their name, contact details, and message. Respond promptly to inquiries — quick responses lead to faster deals! You can see which listing each inquiry is for, when it was sent, and mark inquiries as read once you've followed up.
tommy.dashboard_profile_tip: Manage your personal information here — update your display name, phone number, and email address. This information appears on your listings so buyers can contact you. Keep your phone number up to date as most buyers prefer calling directly. You can also view your account creation date and linked Google account.
tommy.dashboard_edit_tip: Update any detail of your listing — change the title, description, price, photos, or property-specific fields. Changes take effect immediately for active listings. For pending listings, edits will be reviewed along with the original submission. Make sure all information is accurate to attract genuine buyers!
tommy.hub_category_tip: Pick the type of listing — House, Land, PG, Commercial, Vehicle, or Commodity. Each has its own form fields tailored to that category!
tommy.hub_transaction_tip: Are you selling, renting, or leasing? The available options depend on the category you chose above.
tommy.hub_address_tip: Enter the full address — street name, area, city. The more specific you are, the easier it is for buyers to find and visit your property!
tommy.hub_pincode_tip: Enter your 6-digit area pincode. This powers location-based search and helps nearby buyers discover your listing.
tommy.hub_images_tip: Photos are optional but highly recommended! Listings with good quality photos get up to 3x more inquiries. Upload up to 4 photos in JPG, PNG, or WebP format.
tommy.hub_owner_tip: Enter your full name as it should appear on the listing. Buyers will see this when they view your listing details.
tommy.hub_phone_tip: Your 10-digit mobile number. Interested buyers will contact you directly on this number, so make sure it's active and reachable!
tommy.hub_email_tip: Your email address for receiving listing notifications, inquiry alerts, and important updates about your account.
tommy.hub_review_tip: Double-check all your details before submitting. After submission, you'll scan a UPI QR code to pay just ₹10 listing fee. Once admin verifies your payment, your listing goes live on the platform!
